boundaries: Six complete original methods were extracted unchanged: S1/S2 dispense DoWork, both safe-position methods and both domain WaitSingleStep wrappers.

The 68 checks cover normal completion, Fail/Alarm/Abort/Retry mapping, single-step gates, callback/finally behavior, offline branches, safety movement order and exception boundaries; controllers, signals, configuration, coordinates, callbacks, statistics and UI are controlled substitutes.
No production source, project file, SQL, VM, device path or deployment was modified or invoked.
